about.label: About Us
about.heading: Achievements in the
about.p1: Done Solutions is an advisory and consulting firm specializing in Foreign Trade. We offer a complete, efficient and highly qualified structure for international commerce, with deep operational, logistics, tax and customs expertise.
about.p2: We consistently make a difference in the COMEX market through honesty and transparency, building lasting client relationships around the world through excellence in human-centered service.
about.p3: We are ready to plan, guide and detail solutions for direct import and export operations, as well as third-party trade operations.
